defect: combinational stream data retains its previous value when the selected input is invalid
rationale: data_o is assigned only on the valid branch of an always_comb block, so an idle or invalid selected stream infers storage instead of producing a defined combinational value.

mutation.description: Removed the default assignment to data_o from the stream multiplexer combinational block.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the two-input valid-ready multiplexer to its combinational selection logic.
